message: The other day, I found myself grinning like a cat who just caught a mouse. My neighbor, who always rolls his eyes at my weather prep talk, came knocking as the storm clouds rolled in. I handed him a flashlight, some batteries, and a few snacks I had stashed away. He muttered something about being ‘glad I was prepared’ while I tried not to look too smug. It’s funny how a little foresight can turn you into the neighborhood hero. Have you ever had a moment like that?
